name: citric acid + sodium bicarbonate
uses: Uses for the relief of: • heartburn • sour stomach • acid indigestion • upset stomach associated with these symptoms
otcwarn: Do not take more than directed in a 24-hour period or use the maximum dosage of this product for more than 2 weeks, except under the advice and supervision of a physician. Ask a doctor before use if you have a sodium-restricted diet. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
